supporting_observations.claim: At 13:41 UTC, WS-RPATEL-01 (the inventory-designated IT administrator workstation) resolved WS-TWEBER-01 and established a TLS connection to it on port 443. This is consistent with an approved remote-administration source, but the logs do not establish the session's purpose or whether it performed the alerted account action.
WS-ESTONE-01 established TLS connections to WS-TWEBER-01 before and after the alert time, including at 13:49 UTC; these records do not establish what action, if any, was performed in those sessions.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor-coverage metadata reports that winsec and sysmon collection was unavailable on both WS-TWEBER-01 and DC-PIN-01 from 13:30 through 14:15 UTC, covering the reported account-creation time.
The supplied evidence contains no underlying domain account-creation event for it_support, nor an event showing the creating principal, source, group membership, or privileges.
The available network records show TLS connections to WS-TWEBER-01 but do not reveal their application-level actions or tie them to creation of it_support.
claims_not_established: Whether the reported it_support account was created as stated, and the exact time of creation.
Which principal or host created the account, and whether the action was authorized.
Whether it_support was added to any group or granted administrative privileges.
Whether any observed session to WS-TWEBER-01 was used for the account-management action.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain DC-PIN-01 and WS-TWEBER-01 account-management audit events for the window, including account creation and group-membership changes (for example, relevant Windows security events).
Obtain the account's current and historical group membership, privileges, creation metadata, and any subsequent authentication activity.
Correlate the 13:42 UTC activity with endpoint process, PowerShell, authentication, and remote-session telemetry from WS-TWEBER-01, WS-RPATEL-01, and WS-ESTONE-01.
Check the change or service-desk record authorizing creation of it_support and confirm whether its name, purpose, and access match policy.
unrelated_findings: WS-TWEBER-01 recorded a UserAssist entry consistent with execution of PowerShell by tom.weber at 13:27 UTC, before the reported account activity; the evidence does not link it to the alert. (T067-00029)

WS-TWEBER-01 queried afemode.pinecrest.local, received 10.51.20.110, and then attempted a TCP connection to that host on port 1433; this is a separate investigation and does not establish a link to the account alert. (T067-00197, T067-00205)

WS-TWEBER-01 had PostgreSQL-labeled network connections to internal hosts on port 5432; their purpose and relation to any approved application are not established by these records. (T067-00123, T067-00179, T067-00207, T067-00213)
